column3: NKJV adds “When he comes, he will speak to you,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text ends with “by the sea.”
NKJV has “by God,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “by the Lord.”
Close to the Greek; “forgiveness” is rendered “remission.”
NKJV has “in the name of the Lord,” following the Textus Receptus; the critical text reads “in the name of Jesus Christ.”
